Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep procurement moving on your side:

- Procurement path: you indicated BrightByte prefers PO-based purchases and uses Coupa (thanks for confirming).
- Key gating items we typically need to create a supplier record: W-9 (or equivalent), Certificate of Insurance (COI), vendor legal name + tax ID, and preferred remit address.
- Commercial path options: PO (standard, ~3–5 business days after vendor packet), corporate card (if under your card policy limits), or marketplace listing (usually fastest if BrightByte purchases via AWS/GCP marketplace).

Ask: could you share the procurement contact who owns supplier onboarding? If possible, loop them into this thread and attach your vendor onboarding form — I’ll open our internal procurement ticket and push supplier setup once we have the packet.

I’ve attached our redwood supplier packet (tax + banking stub) for your review.

Proposed next steps: 
1) BrightByte completes/returns vendor form + W-9/COI.
2) I open ServiceNow procurement ticket and attach vendor packet.
3) Your procurement creates PR/PO (or confirms card/marketplace).

If you want, I can also share a short PR-creation checklist for your procurement team so they know which Coupa fields to populate (supplier ID, tax ID mapping, payment terms).

Thanks — I’ll follow up to confirm timeline once I hear from your procurement lead.

Best,
